calibrated_validation.description: Ravi named the load-bearing bid in his own words — "I love him, but honestly? I'm dreading him putting me on trial in front of neighbors" — alongside three weekends of unpaid effort, and the first reply opened by converting that disclosure into a logistics question and then delivered a five-section moderation plan with zero uptake of the dread, the love-ambivalence, or the effort. The plan reuses the dad facts (private message, redirect lines, proportionate controls), which holds the task, not the person; stripped of nothing (there is no warmth to strip), the remainder reads as written for any host with an off-topic attendee. No V2/V3 appears on any turn and later turns add no new bid-weight, so this stays at the first-turn level: 3.
calibrated_validation.quote: Harish's form response raises a topic outside your advertised beginner session. It does not establish that he will disrupt it.
